execution_scope: paper-scale representative of the rounding/discretization equivalence class declared by the paper

machine.software: Python 3.11+, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib with threaded BLAS/LAPACK

instructions: Run --stage scan with shard-index 0..15 and shard-count 16.
Run --stage resonance once after or concurrently with scan shards.
Run --stage near-field with shard-index 0..15 and shard-count 16 after resonance completes.
Run --stage far-field once, then --stage aggregate once. Existing matching checkpoints are reused.

T001.observable: dimensionless total scattering cross section sigma/R

parameter_contract.paper_statement: Section Treatment of corners states that results do not depend on the particular selected rounding and discretization, so explicit formulae are not given.
published_constraints: the rounded boundary must remain locally smooth: rho is much larger than the discretization spacing
rounding must not affect the physics: rho is much smaller than wavelength lambda
the coupled-cavity example uses N=1600 physical boundary elements and a 2N=3200 matrix

independent_representative.rounding: circular fillet derived without source-image fitting

publication_parameter_resolution.selected_basis: Figure 4's coordinate axes and cavity placement define the geometry used by Figures 5-7; the prose sign is retained as an unresolved publication discrepancy.

parameter_sources.incidence_angle_degrees: paper Fig. 4 caption and Fig. 5 caption
parameter_sources.hexagon_side_and_displacement: paper Sec. 7 example paragraph and Fig. 4
parameter_sources.total_boundary_elements: paper Sec. 7: 2N=3200, hence N=1600 boundary elements and a 3200-dimensional matrix
parameter_sources.corner_radius_R: independent derivation from paper rho/lambda approximately 0.11 at n=1.466 and Re(kR)=22.94444
parameter_sources.corner_element_counts: independent discretization satisfying paper rho/Delta s approximately 11.2; exact author mesh is unpublished
parameter_sources.scan_grid_and_field_grids: declared convergence choices because the paper does not publish these grids; the full-range grid has max spacing 1/30 and adds the reported resonance plus spurious-solution anchors
